name: Reorder siblings by drag-and-drop in the outliner
body:
# Reorder siblings by drag-and-drop in the outliner

Rows in the outliner can be dragged before other rows, not only onto them. While a drag is going, a drop line sits across each row's top edge. Dropping on it moves the entity just before that row, under the row's parent. Dropping on a row parents under it, and dropping on the empty tail moves to the end of the root. One undo reverts a move.

Needs Penumbra's drag session (penumbra-ui-library board, `drag-and-drop-between-widgets`, fearlessgamedev/penumbra-ui-engine#2) and the bridge mapping (fearlessgamedev/penumbra-bridge#3). Without them, the rows' drag props were inert, so re-parenting by drag didn't work either. See D-054.
